macos_command_file.notes: Primary shortcut workflow for user's current macOS development environment.

macos_automator_or_shortcuts_app.notes: Cleaner app-like wrapper around the .command script; should not duplicate launcher logic.

windows_shortcut.notes: Can be documented later with .bat or PowerShell wrapper if Windows deployment becomes a requirement.

electron.notes: Do not add until launcher and local production app are stable.

tauri.notes: Good future option, but not part of this package.

pywebview_pyinstaller.notes: Python-first executable packaging option after local launcher hardening.
